title: ProbeResult
description: v2 (2026-07-29): outcome of one dry-run request through an agent's current chain — 「试跑一次」 in the agent drawer footer (spec §10.1). Answers 'is this actually working right now' without making the user start a real turn, and replaces the session-level source pinning we explicitly do not build (spec §9). Inherits the resolution-event redaction invariant: classified outcomes only, never raw upstream error bodies.

source_id.description: The source that served (or failed) the probe — the first retry-ready candidate in this backend's chain. null only when the chain was empty, in which case the request fails with probe_no_candidate instead.

model_id.description: The model actually sent upstream, mapping applied. null when the chain was empty.

latency_ms.description: Round trip of the minimal request. null when the attempt never completed (network failure, timeout) — the UI must render that as 未完成, never as 0 ms.

error.description: i18n key when ok=false, reusing the source detail_key vocabulary (models.source.cooldown.*, models.source.needs_action.*). Never raw upstream text. Absent or null when ok=true.

via_mapping.description: true when a per-agent mapping rewrote the requested model id for this probe.
